messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 500s for /v1/embeddings from prod-us-east-1. 300 errors in last 2m. tagging incident and paging oncall :pager:
Aria C: seeing a lot of embed requests getting routed to a chat variant and failing. metric: embed_error_rate up x12.
Kai - oncall: on it, will grab logs. which routing policy is active for customer_alias: 'acme-data'?
Mason (eng-ml): the alias was reassigned during a canary push 04:09 UTC; anchor swap to variant 'gpt-instruct-v2' happened. embed->chat mismatch.
Sana (ops): confirm: fallback policy allowed incompatible variants? I thought we had guardrails.
Mason (eng-ml): we do for new config, but this anchor swap used an old alias that bypassed the compatibility check due to a missing schema flag. gist of config: ```
route {
  alias: "acme-data"
  anchor: "gpt-instruct-v2"
  compatibility_check: false
}
```
Jenn (support): customers are messaging support, first report from ACME at 04:11 UTC: "embeddings are returning html/chat blobs" — they're blocked.
Kai - oncall: immediate mitigation: roll routing for alias back to previous anchor 'embed-optim-v1' and force-fail incompatible fallbacks. executing now.
ops-bot: executing route:update --alias acme-data --anchor embed-optim-v1 --force --dry-run=false
ops-bot: response: success. new route applied in prod-us-east-1.
Aria C: confirm downstream: are pods still serving the chat variant for embed requests? we need to flush caches/kv keys.
Mason (eng-ml): KV prefix cache contains entries mapping alias->anchor, flushing. ```redis-cli -h cache-prod flushdb keys "alias:acme-data*"```
Sana (ops): flushing done. traffic should re-home in next 30s. monitoring token-level routing metrics.
incident-bot: note: error rate decreased 80% 60s after route change.
Jenn (support): pinging ACME with mitigation note: "We rolled routing back and are validating embeddings. ETA 15m."
Kai - oncall: rolling deploy of the canary that introduced the anchor swap is paused and reverted in control plane. opening PR to add stricter schema enforcement.
Mason (eng-ml): temp guard: block any anchor swap where request_type != allowed_types for variant. patch snippet: ```
if variant.type not in allowed_for(request_type):
  reject_anchor_swap()
```
Aria C: good. need to check whether historical requests were mis-processed: run reprocess check for requests 04:05-04:12 UTC and count misrouted embeddings.
Sana (ops): reprocess dry-run shows ~1.2k embedding requests routed to chat variant and 97 failed completely. logging export started to s3://redwood-incident-1736543210/
Jenn (support): classifying affected customers: ACME (severe, blocking), BetaCorp (minor). sending targeted notes.
Kai - oncall: escalation: paging Eng-ML lead for postmortem context and impact calc. @Mason will take lead on RCA.
Mason (eng-ml): taking it. immediate action items: 1) postmortem doc, 2) compatibility enforcement on control plane, 3) add automation test in canary pipeline, 4) customer-impact playbook update.
Aria C: assigning followups: Mason -> RCA, Kai -> incident timeline, Jenn -> customer comms, Sana -> metrics dashboard alert tuning.
ops-bot: creating incident ticket INC-1736543210 with severity P1 and links to logs.
incident-bot: closing pager: error rates back to baseline. please continue with RCA and customer outreach. :white_check_mark:
Jenn (support): ACME confirmed embeddings working again at 04:28 UTC. they requested token-level logs; attaching link.
Kai - oncall: note for handoff: oncall ends in 2h, will summarize in incident channel and leave runbook steps for next rotation.
Mason (eng-ml): preliminary RCA: control plane anchor-swap API allowed a swap without compatibility validation when executed with legacy flag --compat=false. root cause: a stale migration left the flag reachable.
Aria C: impact summary for postmortem: ~1.2k requests misrouted, ~100 failed; 2 customers affected (one blocking). no data exfiltration. customer-facing severity: high for ACME, resolved with route rollback.
Jenn (support): saved customer messages and timeline. will draft outbound note with remediation and apologies.
Sana (ops): proposed fix pushed to staging: disallow anchor-swap if request_type mismatch, add canary test, and add alert when anchor changes for high-traffic aliases.
Mason (eng-ml): will own follow-up patch and will verify canary CI before reenabling anchor swap.
Aria C: thanks team. adding postmortem owners and ETA for doc: EOD tomorrow. closing thread once RCA is posted."
